instructions.sessionMessage.guide: After send: autoWake available → no extra wake; no-live-relay/unsupported → if needed now, wake once via host and tell the user confirmed delivery and that auto-wake is unavailable; wake-unanswered → wake not answered yet. Report only confirmed queueing/delivery, not autoWake. Empty wakes/messages don't stop work; don't guess unreceived bodies.
